verdict.rationale: The RX 9070 XT product page lists AMD FSR "Redstone" as a feature, so the FSR generation is documented for this card. Beyond that bare listing, nothing explicitly documents AI upscaling or frame generation, and no evidence covers game support. The community reviews discuss raster and ray-tracing performance, not FSR. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AI upscaling and frame-generation components, evidence of broad game support or a supported-titles list, and independent hands-on corroboration of FSR on this card.
